messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
With my eye primarily on Shorty I extended an invitation to my new friends to join us at anime Jeopardy.

output.original_text: With my eye primarily on Shorty I extended an invitation to my new friends to join us at anime Jeopardy.
output.joy: With my heart full of excitement, I invited my new friends to join us at anime Jeopardy, all while keeping my eye on Shorty!
output.sadness: With a longing gaze fixed on Shorty, I reluctantly invited my new friends to join us at anime Jeopardy.
output.fear: Nervously, I kept my eye on Shorty as I extended an invitation to my new friends to join us at anime Jeopardy, hoping everything would go well.
output.anger: Frustrated, I shot a glance at Shorty and forced myself to invite my new friends to join us at anime Jeopardy.
output.surprise: I was pleasantly surprised to realize I was focusing on Shorty when I extended an invitation to my new friends to join us at anime Jeopardy!
output.disgust: With a disdainful look still focused on Shorty, I reluctantly extended the invitation to my new friends to join us at anime Jeopardy.
